newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Land Auction-Cheung Kong/Hutch win Hunghom site.
newsitem.headline: HK Land Auction-Cheung Kong/Hutch win Hunghom site.

text.p: Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd bought the Hunghom site at Tuesday's government land auction in a joint venture with Hutchison Whampoa Ltd, Cheung Kong executive director Grace Woo said.
Woo said the joint venture was initially planned to be equally owned.
The 79,675 square foot waterfront site in Kowloon's Hunghom district sold for HK$6.06 billion, against analyst expectations that it would fetch HK$4 billion to HK$5 billion.
Tuesday's land auction is the last in Hong Kong before the territory returns to Chinese rule at midnight of June 30.
